title: HERY Base Entity Schema
description: Defines the five reserved properties for all HERY entities.

_type.description: Entity type URI with version (e.g., amadla.org/entity/application@v1.0.0). Determines which JSON Schema validates this document.

_self.description: Resolvable URI address of this entity instance. Functions as the merge discriminator.

_parent.description: URI to another entity instance of the same type. Enables deep merge inheritance.

_meta.description: Metadata for filtering and search. Structure defined by the entity's schema.

_body.description: Entity content data. Validated against the entity's JSON Schema.
